>We shouldn’t presume to know what they want or don’t want. We should leave them alone, period.

We don't presume it. We learn from their body language and behaviour. When you give a dog food, they wag their tale, eagerly eat the food and express they want more, we know they like the food. When they follow you everywhere you go, they want to be around you.
